synopsis: 30 CFR 56.14132 and 57.14132 are in force for US metal and non-metal mines and cover horns and backup alarms [f2770, f2771]. For self-propelled mobile equipment with an obstructed rear view, they require a reverse-activated alarm, specified alternatives, or an observer; the glossary restates this requirement without the equipment and rear-view qualifications [f2237, f15512]. Reverse alarms must be audible above surrounding noise [f2238, f2772]. These provisions do not require automatic braking, so their alarm requirements should not be treated as an automatic-braking mandate [f2773].

relations.note: Glossary restates the reverse-alarm requirement, omitting equipment and rear-view qualifications.
Both require alarms to be audible above surrounding noise.
Adds horns to the glossary's coverage of reverse alarms, alternatives, and observers.
Specifies the audibility criterion for the glossary's reverse-alarm requirement.
Clarifies that the stated alarm requirement does not mandate automatic braking.
Specifies obstructed rear views and self-propelled equipment for the reverse-alarm requirement.
